output.summary: The 98% on-time figure is an artifact of the KPI definition: dispatchers can replace the promised date, and the original is kept only in a log. Revisions rose 5x after the bonus began. Pell Junction's revisions jumped only when its bonus eligibility began in July, which works like a natural experiment. Customer-request revisions stayed flat, while capacity-reason revisions, late-entered revisions and un-notified revisions all rose. Brightwell's receiving logs show on-time against the original date fell from 87% to 81%. Do not launch the campaign or raise the bonus. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. The driver-shortage link is confounded by lane length, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature. RouteWise and the complaints portal have no evidence.
